The '''Opatajji system''' was a part of the [[Alsaka sector/Legends|Alsaka sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the title of the [[Duke of Opatajji]] as well as the last name of [[Neera Opatajji-Hirken]], who was a [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of the Duke of Opatajji by the time of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Corporate">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Opatajji [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
